company_name: Chiba Institute of Technology, Power Electronics Laboratory（Hayashi Laboratory）
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the Chiba Institute of Technology focuses on research related to sustainable materials and processes that can impact the semiconductor industry.
summary: The Power Electronics Laboratory at Chiba Institute of Technology is engaged in research aimed at achieving sustainability in semiconductor materials and processes. Their work includes the development of functional biomass plastics and polymer separation membranes for helium purification, which are relevant to semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Functional biomass plastics from renewable resources
Polymer separation membranes for helium purification and recycling
